title: Mind panel: relocate the GIMP goal editor out of the Bio tab

sections.what: Move the GIMP goal editor out of the character editor's Bio tab and into the Mind panel's Mind tab. `Player.goals` stays the single source of truth and writes keep going through `ApiClient.updateCharacter(name, { goals })`. The Bio tab no longer renders a Goals section.
sections.why: task-808 authored the goal editor inside the character editor; the Mind panel is becoming the single mind surface (task-714 display; task-729 / task-787 relocation). Goal display already lives in the panel (task-714); only its editing half is still split, so today a designer reads goals in the Mind panel and writes them in the Bio tab. One mind, one editor - same rule task-756 applies to emotions and task-729 to relationships.
sections.how: `mind-view.ts` now renders editable goal rows (`_goalRowHtml`, `_goalsHtml`, `_collectGoals`, `_saveGoals`) and wires them by **event delegation** on `#mind-goals`: `focusout` / `change` save, and a delegated `click` handles add and remove. Delegation means a row added after a render is still wired and no handler binds twice. The old `AV._goalRowHtml` / `_renderGoalsSection` / `_goalList` / `_collectGoals` / `_saveGoals` / `_addGoal` / `_deleteGoal` and the `AV._renderGoalsSection(player, escName)` call were removed from `agent-view.ts`.
sections.verify:
1. Add a goal in the Mind panel, then reload the page.
   - expected: the goal persists and re-renders from `worldState`.
   - observed: VERIFIED 2026-10-13, live on localhost:4444. One click on "➕ Add goal" adds exactly one row; typing a `what` and blurring persisted it to `Player.goals`; a reload re-rendered it. (Probe goal reverted.)
2. Edit and delete the goal in the Mind panel; the Bio tab no longer shows the editor.
   - expected: `updateCharacter({ goals })` fires; Bio has no Goals editor.
   - observed: VERIFIED 2026-10-13. `InspectorAgentView._renderGoalsSection` is `undefined`, and `_renderBioTab`'s HTML no longer contains "🎯 Goals"; the panel sends `updateCharacter` with the collected goals.

acceptance.text: The goal editor lives in the Mind panel and writes `Player.goals` through `updateCharacter({ goals })`.
The Bio tab no longer renders the Goals editor.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Character Inspector → 🧠 Mind → Mind tab → Goals. Bio retains personality, appearance, stats/skills/traits, tags, and aliases, but no goal editor.

Current availability: The card records a live add/edit/reload/delete pass on localhost:4444 on 2026-10-13; the probe goal was reverted after verification.

Live steps when available:
1. Select a character, open Mind → Mind, click “➕ Add goal”, enter a goal and motivation, and blur the field.
   - expected: one row is added, and the updated `Player.goals` appears in `/api/state` after the normal state refresh.
2. Edit the goal's text and status, reload the page, then delete the goal.
   - expected: the edits survive reload; deletion removes that row; the personality field does not change.
3. Open the character's Bio tab and inspect the full tab contents.
   - expected: there is no Bio Goals editor, and the shared player record remains the only source of the goal.

This section defines intended access and live acceptance. It is not a claim that planned UI exists or works today. Current availability says what is implemented and verified now; the numbered steps say how to reach and test the intended surface once it is available.
